Home.heroBadge: Global Food Scanner for Smarter Eating
Home.heroSubtitle: Scan Barcodes, Understand Nutrition, Avoid Allergens
Home.heroDesc: The ultimate food barcode scanner for smarter, healthier eating. Get instant nutrition facts, health scores, and allergen alerts with a single scan.
Home.featuresTitle: Everything You Need to Understand Your Food
Home.featureInstantScanDesc: Scan any product barcode to unlock comprehensive nutrition facts and ingredient analysis in seconds. No more guesswork at the supermarket.
Home.featureScoresDesc: Get clear food scores based on calories, sugar, fats, salt, and protein. Our data-driven insights guide you toward nutrient-dense choices that support your health goals.
Home.featureAllergensDesc: Shop with confidence. Receive instant warnings for common allergens like gluten, lactose, nuts, and soy. Perfect for managing food sensitivities and keeping your family safe.
Home.aboutP1: Nutrika isn't just a scanner; it’s a guide for your healthy lifestyle. Whether you are focused on clean eating, building a plant-based diet, or managing specific dietary restrictions, Nutrika simplifies the complex world of food labels.
Home.aboutP2: Nutrika simplifies the complex world of food labels.
Home.pillarAccurateDesc: Nutrika analyzes calories, fats, sugars, protein, and micronutrients to help you choose foods that support your health goals. By searching for nutrition facts, high protein foods, and healthy eating tips, Nutrika guides you exactly to what your body needs.
Home.pillarAllergenDesc: Millions of people worldwide look for allergen info before buying food. With Nutrika, get instant warnings about common triggers like gluten, lactose, nuts, and soy, helping users with food intolerance or allergies shop with confidence.
Home.pillarHealthyDesc: Whether you follow a keto diet, high protein meal plan, plant-based lifestyle, or general balanced diet, Nutrika helps you understand nutritional quality across high protein foods, healthy eating, and diet plan ideas.
Home.howDesc: Nutrika uses barcode data and trusted databases to provide fast analysis in three simple steps. Ideal for daily use at the supermarket, at home, or on the go.
Home.step1Desc: Point your camera at any food product barcode.
Home.step2Desc: View calories, macros, and instant health scores.
Home.step3Desc: Make smarter food choices based on data insights.
Home.testimonialsDesc: See what our community is saying about Nutrika and how it has changed their daily eating habits.
Home.review1Text: Nutrika is a game-changer! I can instantly see if a product fits my macros. It saves me so much time at the grocery store.
Home.review2Text: Having a gluten intolerance makes shopping stressful. With Nutrika's instant alerts, I finally feel safe buying new snacks.
Home.review3Text: I love the Eco-score feature. It helps me choose better products for my kids and the environment. Highly recommended!
Home.faq1A: Yes, our core scanning and scoring features are free for everyone.
Home.faq2A: Nutrika relies on comprehensive, globally recognized food databases such as Open Food Facts, combined with our proprietary data validation algorithms to ensure maximum accuracy.
Home.faq3A: Our scores are highly accurate and based on the standard Nutri-Score calculation rules, incorporating calories, saturated fats, sugars, sodium, protein, and fiber.
Home.faq4A: You need an internet connection to scan new products. However, previously scanned items and your history are cached locally so you can view them anytime.

About.metaDescription: Learn more about Nutrika, your smart nutrition companion. Discover how we calculate scores and empower healthier eating.
About.heroDesc: Empowering you to make healthier, more informed food choices every day.
About.missionDesc: At Nutrika, we believe that understanding what you eat shouldn't require a degree in nutrition. Our mission is to make food transparency accessible to everyone by providing instant, easy-to-understand insights into the products you consume.
About.whyBuiltDesc: Navigating the grocery store can be overwhelming. With complex ingredient lists, hidden sugars, and confusing nutritional labels, making the right choice for your health and diet goals is challenging. We built Nutrika to cut through the noise. By simply scanning a barcode, you unlock a wealth of information—from basic macros to detailed allergen alerts and comprehensive eco-scores.
About.featureScanDesc: Point your camera at any barcode and instantly retrieve comprehensive nutritional data.
About.featureScoringDesc: We utilize trusted, science-backed systems like Nutri-Score and Eco-Score.
About.featureAlertsDesc: Stay safe with immediate warnings for allergens and dietary restrictions.
About.scoresIntro: Our primary Product Score (0-100) evaluates food quality comprehensively. It starts from a neutral base score of 85, applying adjustments based on positive and negative factors:
About.factorSugarDetail: Very high sugar (>22.5g) costs -20 pts, high sugar (>10g) costs -10 pts, low sugar (<5g) earns +3 pts; high sat. fat (>5g) costs -10 pts, low sat. fat (<1.5g) earns +3 pts
About.factorSaltDetail: Salt over 1.5g per 100g costs -10 pts; salt under 0.3g earns +3 pts
About.factorFiberDetail: High fiber (>3g) and high protein (>10g) each earn +8 bonus points
About.factorNovaDetail: NOVA 4 (ultra-processed) gets -10 pts, NOVA 3 gets -5 pts, NOVA 1 (unprocessed) gets +8 pts
About.factorAdditivesDetail: Each controversial additive (MSG, aspartame, artificial colors) costs -6 pts (capped at -20); no additives earns +5 pts
About.factorOrganicDetail: Products with Organic or Bio certification earn a bonus
About.nutriscoreBlendDesc: If a product has an official Nutri-Score, we blend it with our custom score (80% custom + 20% Nutri-Score). A Nutri-Score A adds up to +10 bonus points, while an E subtracts up to 10 points.
About.trustDesc: Nutrika is an independent platform. We do not accept advertising or sponsored product placements. Our data is enriched through local Tunisian databases and user contributions.

Product.allergenWarningDesc: This product contains ingredients that match your saved allergies: <allergens></allergens>.
Product.scoreProductDesc: A comprehensive score starting at 85 points. It's penalized for high sugar, saturated fat, salt, harmful additives, and heavy processing (NOVA 3–4). It's rewarded for low sugar/fat/salt, fiber, protein, organic/vegan labels, no additives, and minimal processing (NOVA 1). Finally, it's blended with the official Nutri-Score (80% custom + 20% Nutri-Score).
Product.scoreLetterDesc: Derived directly from the Product Score (A: 85-100, B: 70-84, C: 50-69, D: 30-49, E: <30).
Product.scoreNutriDesc: Evaluates nutritional quality per 100g, penalizing energy, sugars, fat, and sodium, while rewarding fruits, vegetables, fiber, and protein.
Product.scoreEcoDesc: Measures environmental impact evaluating farming, processing, packaging, and transport origins.

Product.reviewPremiumDesc: Upgrade to Premium to leave reviews and help others make better choices.

Privacy.metaDescription: Privacy policy and data handling practices for Nutrika.
Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.subtitle: How we protect and manage your personal data.
Privacy.section1Content: Welcome to Nutrika. We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This privacy policy will inform you about how we look after your personal data when you visit our website and use our application.
Privacy.section2Content: We may collect, use, store, and transfer different kinds of personal data about you, which we have grouped together as follows:
Privacy.section2List1: Identity Data: includes first name, last name, username or similar identifier.
Privacy.section2List3: Technical Data: includes internet protocol (IP) address, your login data, browser type and version, time zone setting and location.
Privacy.section2List4: Usage Data: includes information about how you use our application, including scanned products and search history.
Privacy.section3Content: We will only use your personal data when the law allows us to. Most commonly, we will use your personal data in the following circumstances:
Privacy.section3List1: To register you as a new user.
Privacy.section3List2: To manage our relationship with you.
Privacy.section3List3: To personalize your experience and deliver relevant content and product suggestions.
Privacy.section3List4: To improve our website, products/services, marketing, customer relationships, and experiences.
Privacy.section4Content: We have put in place appropriate security measures to prevent your personal data from being accidentally lost, used, or accessed in an unauthorized way, altered, or disclosed.
Privacy.section5Content: Under certain circumstances, you have rights under data protection laws in relation to your personal data, including the right to request access, correction, erasure, or restriction of processing of your personal data.
Privacy.section6Content: If you have any questions about this privacy policy or our privacy practices, please contact us at support@nutrika.com.
